name: scenario_6_sla_breach_ack_timeout
description: A critical SLA response-time breach pages Elena Ross (Platform Lead, sla 5, q 8.00). She does not acknowledge within the window, so the ack-timeout rule (R4c) escalates IN PARALLEL to Nina Osei (sla 3, q 3.60) — SLA semantics: a critical breach does not wait for an ack. Demonstrates the ack-timeout escalation path on the new sla domain.
